confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Gyeongju price levels; not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies a lot by weekend and summer demand. Cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weak. The FX rate comes from RBA exchange-rate pages surfaced in search results, and I did not open the RBA daily table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on small historic Korean tourism cities such as Jeonju and Andong, with price levels set below Seoul. Accommodation assumes July, which is the start of peak domestic summer travel.
